mass_diag_iso.model: 2-coefficient diagnostic Y = c0 + c1 x, x = (p_F/m)^2 of the isotropic release form

mass_diag_own.model: 2-coefficient diagnostic Y = c0 + c1 x, x = f_kin/0.3 (an equivalent cold-isotropic kinetic parameter of each stored preparation, the composer's cold-gas conversion)

size_diag_third.model: 2-coefficient diagnostic Y = c0 + c1 (a/r_s)^(1/3) on the certified size members

size_diag_third_with_uncertified.model: 2-coefficient diagnostic Y = c0 + c1 (a/r_s)^(1/3) including uncertified formation records (labelled; no law)

width_cross_certified.model: Y = c0 + c1 z + c2 h + c3 z h, z = ln(a/r_s), h = ln(sigma/a), on the certified points

width_cross_with_uncertified.model: Y = c0 + c1 z + c2 h + c3 z h, z = ln(a/r_s), h = ln(sigma/a), on every formation record (labelled)

definitions:
version 1.3 (ReviewA_cert_rule_v1, the production rule): two extents per member, the 30.3 prefix (before the first record whose
    kept residual exceeds 1e-3) and the certified prefix (before the first non-counting record: kept or confirming residual above 1e-3),
    a history being certified to its last record before the first that fails; records counting with either residual above 1e-4 are banded; the last converged record is the certified prefix's last record; a formation is certified when its
    record lies inside the certified prefix; every readout carries the record's own counting flag and its certified flag.
